start:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
loop [each item]
  user -> app: add
  opt [in stock]
    app --> user: added
  end
end
@enduml

after.text:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
loop [each item]
  opt [in stock]
    app --> user: added
  end
  user -> app: add
end
@enduml

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Fragment — opt":
  - heading "Fragment — opt" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Kind
  - combobox "Kind":
    - option "alt — alternative"
    - option "opt — optional" [selected]
    - option "loop — iterative"
    - option "par — parallel"
    - option "break — early exit"
    - option "critical — atomic section"
    - option "ref — reference to another interaction"
    - option "neg — forbidden trace"
  - text: Condition
  - textbox "Condition": in stock
  - group "Fragment order":
    - text: Fragment order
    - button "Move earlier"
    - button "Move later"
  - button "Remove fragment (keep inner messages)"
  - paragraph: Double-click [condition] / [otherwise] on the canvas to edit in place. Click a message inside to edit its source, target, or branch. Press Delete to remove the entire fragment block.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
